brand.slogan: The cloud platform that helps your company work better.

home.titolo: All your company’s work, in one place
home.sottotitolo: {{siteName}} brings users, processes and data together in an easy-to-use platform, available on computers, tablets and smartphones.

disponibile.title: Always available
disponibile.text: Nothing to install: sign in from your browser wherever you are, with data always up to date.

sicuro.title: Secure
sicuro.text: Each company’s data is kept separate and every user sees only what they need.

team.title: Built for teams
team.text: Roles and permissions for administrators and staff, with a tailored menu for each.

assistente.title: Built-in assistant
assistente.text: Ask the assistant what to do: it guides you through pages and features.

registrati.title: Sign up
registrati.text: Create your company in a minute, no credit card required.

configura.title: Set up
configura.text: Add your staff and choose what each of them can see.

lavora.title: Work
lavora.text: Use the platform every day, from any device.

home.chiusuraTesto: Register your company and try the platform with your staff.

features.sottotitolo: The core tools to organise your company, ready from your first sign-in.

aziende.title: Company management
aziende.text: Company and user records, with administrators and staff.

ruoli.title: Roles and access
ruoli.text: Each role sees only its own pages; the administrator decides which menu items to show.

struttura.title: Firms and dealers
struttura.text: A multi-level structure: dealers, professional firms and client companies.

impersonate.title: Sign in on behalf of
impersonate.text: Support staff can sign in on behalf of a user and switch back with one click.

notifiche.title: Real-time notifications
notifiche.text: Alerts and progress of long-running jobs, without reloading the page.

dispositivi.title: On every device
dispositivi.text: One interface for computers, tablets and smartphones, with light and dark themes.

pricing.sottotitolo: Simple plans with no commitment: start free and grow when you need to.
pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. You can change plan or cancel at any time.

carta.domanda: Do I need a credit card to get started?
carta.risposta: No: the Free plan is free with no expiry; you only pay if you move to a higher plan.

utenti.risposta: Yes, at any time; if you exceed your plan’s limits we will suggest the right one.

dati.risposta: In European data centres, kept separate for each company and backed up daily.

about.sottotitolo: A team that has been building business software for years, alongside companies and professionals.
about.paragrafo1: We believe business software should be simple: a few clear pages that do their job well.
about.paragrafo2: That is why we develop {{siteName}} together with the people who use it every day, adding features based on real needs.

semplicita.title: Simplicity
semplicita.text: Every feature must be clear the first time you use it.

affidabilita.title: Reliability
affidabilita.text: Customer data is safe and always available.

vicinanza.title: Closeness
vicinanza.text: We answer questions and listen to suggestions.

contact.sottotitolo: Got questions or want a demo? Write to us and we will reply within one working day.
contact.testoModulo: Fill in the form: your email program will open with the message ready to send.

register.sottotitolo: Create your company account and start using the platform right away.

vantaggi.attiva: Up and running in a minute

ticketTypeEdit.title: Request type
ticketTypeEdit.levelsNote: The ticket is opened, moves up and is visible only in the enabled levels: it moves to the first enabled level above the current one.
ticketTypeEdit.levelsRequired: Enable at least two levels: one that opens the ticket and one that receives it.
ticketTypeEdit.activeNote: An inactive type can no longer be selected, but stays on existing tickets.

aiDocumentList.title: AI documentation
aiDocumentList.info: Documents the AI assistant uses for automatic answers to tickets that reach this level. Their content is sent to the AI service.
aiDocumentList.readOnly: Read only: documents are changed by the PowerAdmin.
aiDocumentList.noScope: No level whose documentation you can manage.
aiDocumentList.deleteConfirm: Delete the document "{{title}}"? Answers already given still mention it by title.

aiDocumentEdit.title: AI document
aiDocumentEdit.readOnly: Read only: the document is changed by the PowerAdmin.
aiDocumentEdit.descrizioneNote: What the document is for: it helps the AI assistant decide when to use it.
aiDocumentEdit.ticketTypesNote: The document is used only for tickets of these types. No type = all types.
aiDocumentEdit.includeSubLevelsNote: The document is also used for tickets reaching the levels below this one (for example the manual uploaded once for all companies).
aiDocumentEdit.fileNote: PDF, Word, OpenDocument, Excel or text, up to 10 MB: the file text replaces the content, which you can then correct.
aiDocumentEdit.fileExtension: The file type of {{name}} is not allowed.
aiDocumentEdit.fileSize: The file {{name}} is empty or exceeds {{max}} MB.
aiDocumentEdit.replaceContent: The file text replaces the current content. Continue?
aiDocumentEdit.contenutoNote: This is the text the AI assistant reads to answer.
aiDocumentEdit.contenutoRequired: The content is required: write it or upload a file.
aiDocumentEdit.contenutoTooLong: The content exceeds {{max}} characters: split it into several documents.
aiDocumentEdit.orderNote: If there are too many documents for one answer, the AI assistant reads those with the lowest order first.
aiDocumentEdit.activeNote: A disabled document is not used by the AI assistant.

ticketTypeAiSetting.title: AI answers
ticketTypeAiSetting.noScope: No level whose AI answers you can manage.
ticketTypeAiSetting.infoDefault: Default values: they apply to all nodes of the level that do not customize them. For DEV they are the only values.
ticketTypeAiSetting.infoNode: For each request type you can use the default values or customize them.
ticketTypeAiSetting.infoDocuments: When a ticket reaches the level the AI assistant answers, if it is enabled and there are documents for the type. After the given number of attempts the ticket goes to an operator.
ticketTypeAiSetting.readOnly: Read only: settings are changed by the PowerAdmin.
ticketTypeAiSetting.empty: No request type enabled at this level.
ticketTypeAiSetting.useParentDocuments: Use the documentation of the upper levels
ticketTypeAiSetting.infoParentDocuments: "Use the documentation of the upper levels": the assistant also uses the documents of the upper levels (and of the SuperUser) published for the lower levels; off, it uses only the node's own documents.

licenseCatalogList.title: Licence price lists
licenseCatalogList.note: One price list per subject type and function, with the Free, Standard and Pro plans. The price lists of an enabled centre replace the global ones for its companies and firms.
licenseCatalogList.confirmDeactivate: The price list has {{count}} active licences: it will only be disabled (licences stay valid until they expire). Continue?

licenseCatalogEdit.title: Licence price list
licenseCatalogEdit.readOnly: Read-only price list: only its owner can change it.
licenseCatalogEdit.subject: Subject type
licenseCatalogEdit.inUseNote: The price list has {{count}} active licences: subject type and function cannot be changed.
licenseCatalogEdit.availableOnCompanies: The firm's licences apply to all its companies
licenseCatalogEdit.availableOnCompaniesNote: On: when the firm subscribes to a plan, all its companies (including those created later) are covered without subscribing themselves.
licenseCatalogEdit.activeNote: A disabled price list is no longer offered; licences already subscribed stay valid until they expire.
licenseCatalogEdit.freeNote: The Free plan is always free of charge.
licenseCatalogEdit.maxUsersNote: Empty or 0 = unlimited. Raising the limit applies at once to active licences too; lowering it applies from the renewal.
licenseCatalogEdit.maxUsersInvalid: Limits cannot be negative (empty or 0 = unlimited).

licenseSettings.title: Licence settings
licenseSettings.enabledNote: Off: no function is limited and everyone is at the Pro level; price lists and subscriptions can still be used.
licenseSettings.defaultStorage: Default storage of the plans in MB (Documents)
licenseSettings.defaultUsersNote: Proposed when a new price list is created; empty or 0 = unlimited. Existing price lists do not change.
licenseSettings.graceDaysNote: During these days the licence is still valid and a renewal reminder is shown.
licenseSettings.warningDaysNote: How many days before expiry the e-mail reminder is sent to the administrators.
licenseSettings.invalid: To save: users not negative (empty or 0 = unlimited), days between 0 and 365.
licenseSettings.dealers: Centres that manage their own price lists
licenseSettings.dealersNote: An enabled centre can define its own price lists, which replace the global ones for its companies and firms.

licenseManagement.overLimit4: The storage used exceeds the licence: upgrade to a higher plan or delete some documents.
licenseManagement.bundleNote: A single licence for all functions.
licenseManagement.coveredCompaniesNote: The firm's licences cover all its companies, including those created after the subscription.
licenseManagement.ownHigherPlan: Has its own higher plan for: {{funzioni}}
